- Quality(5/5): I rate the food here as delicious enough, but not so great. The baked dishes are not too spicy and moderate, and the food is very fresh.

The restaurant space is nice and the view is nice.
Mar 2024 • Friends
We arrived at the restaurant fairly early at 4pm and sat upstairs, but the downstairs doesn't open until 5pm. When you hear Da Lat, everyone mentions Bag Mo To, so you should be able to enjoy the grilled dishes there. The seasoned meat is delicious. The green salt and orange here are delicious when dipped in vegetables.
That day, I ordered cheese-wrapped beef, kimchi-wrapped pork, and grilled pork ribs. It's been a long time since I've had such delicious baked food. The food here is a bit expensive.
